full_judgment: 10. Respondent No. 4 also filed an affidavit-in-opposition alleging mainly that the disputed property was a Debottar Property, that the name of Akhanda Kumar Bose was recorded as Shebayet in the C.S. Khatian, that on his death his son Proddyut Kumar Bose continued as the Shebayet (trustee), that he is a citizen of Bangladesh by birth and has been living here, that the alleged deed of exchange and the power of attorney purported to have been executed by Proddyut Kumar Bose were fraudulent and not genuine and that the deed of Settlement in favour of the appellants was rightly set aside.
